Cim Holds Position in Novo (NVO); Fabrinet (FN) Position Has Boosted by Quentec Asset Management Llc
May 17, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Quentec Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Fabrinet (FN) by 33.97% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Quentec Asset Management Llc bought 214,015 shares as the company’s stock rose 6.60% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 844,066 shares of the telecommunications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $24.23M, up from 630,051 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Quentec Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Fabrinet for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.36 billion market cap company. The stock increased 3.16% or $1.13 $36.92. About 421,437 shares traded. Fabrinet (NYSE:FN) has declined 29.14% since May 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 40.69% the S&P500.
Cim Llc increased its stake in Novo (NVO) by 4.13% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cim Llc bought 8,020 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.08% with the market. The institutional investor held 202,053 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $10.84M, up from 194,033 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cim Llc who had been investing in Novo for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $116.45 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.31% or $0.63 $48.86. About 1.63M shares traded or 10.32% up from the average. Novo Nordisk A/S (NYSE:NVO) has risen 42.07% 30.52% the S&P500.
